data.other_hard: Applicants must have Bachelors Degree Certificate to apply; Final year undergraduate students are also eligible to apply for admission
data.evidence_sentence: All National and International Students from any part of the world are eligible to apply for Doha Institute Scholarships.
data.notes: Page lists two awards (Tamim Scholarships merit-based and SANAD Grant financial need); both described with similar benefits. Page is titled 2024 in URL but content refers to 2027-2028 session; contains unrelated promotional links to other scholarships (KAUST, OIST, BYD) which were ignored. Encouraged to apply for Master's or PhD is a preference, not a requirement. Schools listed as Public Administration & Development Economics, Social Sciences and Humanities, Conflict and Humanitarian Studies; field restrictions not clearly stated since applicants can take admission in any field. Degree level stated as Masters, PhD in details table; 'Full Free' and 'Fully Funded' used for funding; monthly allowance and tuition covered for both awards.
